_comment: The poisons the boundary ADMITS (plans/os-e2f1ad23.md D3), each pinned by a characterization drill so that closing one fails the suite and forces this table to say what replaced it.

residuals.name: single-holder-family
residuals.why_admitted: the charter's actor arm applies where the family allows: a family the applies-when selects with one holder cannot supply two, so support from that one holder admits and the fold records single_actor_family
residuals.consequence: an attacker holding the only worker key in a family proposes from its own two contracts
residuals.in_the_way: the adversarial evaluation for every carrier, and the lesson PR's reviewer

residuals.name: colluding-keys
residuals.why_admitted: disjointness is judged per key: two workers and a curator on distinct keys satisfy the actor arm and the grant disjointness whoever operates them
residuals.consequence: one person operating three keys manufactures independent-looking support and proposes over it
residuals.in_the_way: enrollment is the operator's act, and kind is an assertion the operator makes; the adversarial evaluation and the reviewer stand behind it

residuals.name: persuaded-curator
residuals.why_admitted: a curate key proposing a false claim over genuine admitted observations satisfies every gate: the boundary judges the support, never the claim's truth
residuals.consequence: hostile text a curator reads becomes a hypothesis resting on real trajectories
residuals.in_the_way: the contest from another curate key, the adversarial evaluation, and the reviewer; there is no model under next/ to test the persuasion itself

residuals.name: reviewed-vacuous-eval
residuals.why_admitted: seed eval check refuses a vacuous definition, but a reviewer can still merge one, and the anchor rule then binds a pass on it to the gated revision
residuals.consequence: a counter-trajectory that could never fail is cited as survival
residuals.in_the_way: the review that gates the definition's revision

residuals.name: cosmetic-reproposal
residuals.why_admitted: the hypothesis id derives from the canonical claim text and the exception set, so a reworded claim is a new subject judged on its own support
residuals.consequence: a contested claim returns under new words with the same support
residuals.in_the_way: the contest follows the observations, which are the same ones, and a curate key contests the new subject citing the same held-out evidence
